pcem.note: Cycle-accurate 486 reference used as the 486-cost gate. Optional: DOSBox-X remains the parity gate, so a machine without PCem can still build and run the timedemo. Hash recorded 2026-09-30 from the v17 release asset; pin before promoting anything on PCem cycles.

extraInstalls.name: manual
extraInstalls.note: Hand-extracted copy outside the managed toolchain. Not written by bootstrap; tools\pcem-roms.ps1 wires its [Paths] roms_paths so the interactive hand-run path finds the same ROM set.

pcemRomset.note: PCem ships no ROMs by design (README.md: 'NO COPYRIGHTED ROM FILES ARE INCLUDED NOR WILL THEY BE'). This set is consumed in place via [Paths] roms_paths rather than copied, so it stays the single source of truth. The machine and the BIOS filename are not arbitrary: src\model.c:227 defines the profile as {[486] Award SiS 496/497, ROM_SIS496, "sis496", ...} and src\mem_bios.c:549 reads exactly sis496/sis496-1.awa for ROM_SIS496, as 0x20000 (131072) bytes. CMOS for this machine is laid out by the Award BIOS, so tools\pcem-machine.psm1 provisions its NVR from the install's nvr\default\sis496.nvr; see that module for the offsets.

dosImage.note: Bootable 1.44 MB FAT12 floppy, volume label BOOT622, containing IO.SYS/MSDOS.SYS/COMMAND.COM/HIMEM.SYS. CONFIG.SYS already loads HIMEM.SYS /testmem:off, which is what CWSDPMI needs for XMS. Hash-verified SOURCE of the four DOS binaries (IO.SYS, MSDOS.SYS, COMMAND.COM, HIMEM.SYS) that tools\pcem-stage.ps1 installs onto C: of dos.hdd. Never modified; no longer attached as a floppy - the HDD boots itself.
